text: LIV Golf confirmed on 17 August 2026 that the Aramco LIV Golf Michigan Team Championship (Aug 27-30, The Cardinal at Saint John's Resort) 'will not take place', making Indianapolis the 2026 season finale - weeks after PIF said it would stop funding the league at season's end.
short: LIV cancelled the Aramco Team Championship in Michigan in August 2026.

source.name: Sky Sports
source.quote: the previously scheduled Aramco LIV Golf Michigan, originally set for August 27-30, at The Cardinal at Saint John's Resort, will not take place.
